references.text: Samgar struck down 600 Philistines and saved Israel, showing God's pattern of raising up deliverers for his people.
The oppression of Israel by the Midianites and the people's cry to the Lord follows the same pattern as in Judges 10:12.
When the Israelites cried out to the Lord, he raised up a deliverer for them, just as described here.
The attack on Israel by the Amalekites in the wilderness, which God later punished them for.
The kings of Canaan fought against Israel, but the Lord gave victory.
Samuel reminded the people how they cried out to the Lord when enemies oppressed them, and the Lord sent deliverers.
The Lord looked on them in their distress when he heard their cry, and he remembered his covenant.
The oppression of Israel by the Canaanites for twenty years led the people to cry out to the Lord.
Nehemiah describes the same pattern: oppression, crying out to God, and God's deliverance through the rescuers.
